answer: The coefficient estimate for age in the simple logistic regression (response ~ age) is approximately -0.075 change in log-odds per year of age (b1 = -0.074954; SE 0.0244, 95% CI [-0.1227, -0.0272], p = 0.0021; equivalently an odds ratio of ~0.928 per year). That is, each additional year of age is associated with a decrease of about 0.075 in the log-odds of treatment response (PR vs SD/PD) among the 80 patients.
